/**
 * Query parameter names commonly used in open-redirect gadget chains (CWE-601).
 */
export const OPEN_REDIRECT_QUERY_PARAM_KEYS = [
  'redirect',
  'redirect_uri',
  'redirect_url',
  'redirecturl',
  'next',
  'url',
  'return',
  'returnurl',
  'return_url',
  'goto',
  'destination',
  'continue',
  'target',
  'forward',
  'out',
  'redir',
  'rurl',
  'view',
  'to',
] as const;

const OPEN_REDIRECT_QUERY_PARAM_KEY_SET = new Set<string>(
  OPEN_REDIRECT_QUERY_PARAM_KEYS.map((key) => key.toLowerCase()),
);

export const isOpenRedirectQueryParamKey = (key: string): boolean =>
  OPEN_REDIRECT_QUERY_PARAM_KEY_SET.has(key.toLowerCase());
